full_name: Andrew O'Donohue | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2025–2026 Social Sciences Arleen Carlson and Edna Nelson Graduate Fellow Harvard University
bio: Andrew O’Donohue is a political scientist studying democratic backsliding, law and politics, and political polarization. His dissertation, a book, examines why the judiciary defends—or instead undermines—democracy through original interviews with high-ranking judges and lawyers in Israel and Turkey.
